title: Why Does a Straw Work?
hook: You do not really suck the drink up by magic.
narration: You do not really suck the drink up by magic.
This 3D Short is only about this: Why Does a Straw Work.
You lower the air pressure in the straw.
Let me show you that in 3D.
Outside air then pushes the drink up.
Watch this next bit closely. This is why it happens.
Air pressure is the hidden helper.
So the idea is simple: cause, then effect.
Remember: You do not really suck the drink up by magic.
The pictures today are a new water world. Not yesterday's film.
That is the whole idea, in one short 3D film.
Stay to the end. The last shot is the takeaway for why does a straw work.
Tomorrow a brand new 3D film. Same curious science. Brand new pictures.
